**AI Engineer

**AI is moving from prototypes to production-ready solutions. The engineers who can take it there matter more than ever.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We're looking for an AI Engineer who is as comfortable in the code as in the data underneath it. Someone who can design, build, and ship AI solutions today, and grow into setting technical direction as the company grows.

On smaller engagements, you may be the only engineer on the project, which means owning it from problem to production yourself. On larger ones, you'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where ideas move quickly, and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• Designing and deploying AI solutions across domains like finance, operations, and supply chain

• Building predictive models, automated workflows, and agentic systems

• Owning the data work behind your own models and agents

• Building eval systems that measure whether an agent actually works

• Leading client projects from problem to production

• Translating business needs into AI solutions that actually ship

• Integrating scalable AI systems through APIs and cloud environments

**Requirements

****You probably have experience with

**

• Software development, ML or data engineering, with AI applications running in production

• Fluent Python and at least one agent framework or SDK

• Training ML models and handling the data preparation behind them

• Building or extending eval systems for agent behaviour

• Building scalable systems in cloud environments like Azure or GCP

• Coding with agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor

• Stakeholder management and leading delivery end-to-end

Curiosity, taste and builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Remote work allowed

• Pet friendly

Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems
 Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  
 The Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN); Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as full Professor within the area of microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems.

  Research and teaching at PLEN covers topics within Agriculture, Plant Science, Biotechnology, Biosolutions and Environmental Sciences, dealing with a wide range of subjects focusing especially on plants, soil, and microorganisms from molecules through organisms to populations and anthropogenic ecosystems. It is our vision to maintain and develop our position as one of the leading departments for plant science and the related areas based on excellent basic and applied research.

  The department hosts state-of-the art infrastructure and unique field research facilities, with many opportunities for collaborations across the department. The department is organised into four sections, and the appointed professor will be affiliated to the section of Environmental Sciences located at the Frederiksberg campus.

  The section of Environmental Sciences carries out world-leading research across diverse disciplines, including soil microbiology, chemistry, agrohydrology, ecotoxicology, to assess and mitigate human impacts on ecosystems. By combining measurements, experiments, and modelling, the section supports both basic environmental science and applied solutions for sustainable agriculture, climate mitigation, and clean soil and water. The section of Environmental Sciences conducts world-leading research covering environmental biology, chemistry, and ecosystem science. Focusing on agroecosystems and impacts on soil, water, and the atmosphere, the section connects fundamental discoveries to solutions for targeting climate impacts, microbial diversity, and toxicological challenges.

  The professor is expected to teach both at the BSc and MSc levels primarily in the Biotechnology and the Natural resources and Environmental Sciences programmes at the Frederiksberg Campus and to expand these regular teaching commitments to the new MSc in Biosolutions in Kalundborg.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Description of qualifications needed

  The professorship is advertised within the area of microbial solutions for climate-friendly and sustainable production systems. Full exploitation of these solutions requires basic understanding of the complex interactions in the environment which shape microbial communities and their functions in soil and at the plant root interface.

  Hence, the appointed professor should have a broad knowledge of microbial ecology including microbial functioning under soil conditions, drivers for microbiome assembly as well as microbe-microbe and plant-microbe interactions of importance for soil and plant health. It is expected that the professor has a recognized international position in the field and contributes to the design and implementation of new methodologies within microbial ecology. The successful candidate is expected to drive research within:

   	
• Model system development for causality and mechanistic understanding of microbial functioning under natural soil conditions 	
• The microbial component of N and P nutrition in agricultural systems 	
• Drivers for root colonization and microbial assembly in agricultural systems 	
• Microbial functions of importance for soil health and functioning 	
• Microbial solutions for climate mitigation and sustainable plant production   The appointed professor is expected to cover teaching in existing courses both at the MSc and BSc levels in subjects related to microbiology, molecular genetics and biotechnology. Likewise, the appointed professor is expected to be a driver for the development of courses to ensure high-quality teaching in a constantly changing educational landscape. Supervision of BSc and MSc projects is expected on a regular basis. International candidates are expected to be able to contribute actively to teaching in Danish within 3-6 years, including supervision and assessment of students. Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

  The candidate should fulfil the following criteria:

   	
• PhD or similar in molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, or a related field 	
• Profound experience in the study of plant microbe-related issues in the context of sustainable agriculture 	
• An excellent publication record that includes corresponding-author, senior author and first author publications of relevance to the position and demonstrate an impact on the scientific field of microbial interactions related to soils, plants and the environment 	
• Proven leadership in an academic research environment and ability to guide an independent research group to achieve specific goals 	
• Extensive experience in the development, organization, restructuring, and management of courses at BSc and MSc levels, supported by a comprehensive teaching portfolio that documents pedagogic competences and ongoing skills development. 	
• Extensive experience with supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students, as well as postdocs 	
• A teaching portfolio that documents teaching experience and reflections on teaching skills 	
• Documented ability to obtain independent research grants from private and public foundations. 	
• A strong track record of successful external/international collaborations. 	
• Documented experience in organizational tasks such as departmental committees 	
• Experience with outreach activities and communication of research to the public and stakeholders via, e.g., popular science events, press releases, interviews, conferences etc 	
• Societal impact in terms of participation in appropriate stakeholder networks   Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf
 
 Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  
 Salary and employment conditions

  The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.   There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Further information on the department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department Morten Petersen (morten.petersen@plen.ku.dk).

  
 Filing of application
 The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers    

  The deadline for applications is 8 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 18 March 2027.

  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0367/26-2K.

Join Us

**Join a 5x Private Equity growth journey and build amazing frontend solutions as we turn Frontline Workers into Frontline Winners

**We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead complex frontend initiatives across the Relesys platform. You will take ownership from an initially ambiguous product problem through technical design, delivery, rollout and learning in production.

Working closely with Product, Design, backend engineers and other frontend engineers, you will create clarity, make architectural trade-offs and help the team deliver maintainable, accessible and high-quality product experiences. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with significant technical and project leadership responsibility.

A significant part of the role will be helping us evolve our frontend architecture incrementally while continuing to deliver customer value. Our product includes modern and established frontend technologies, and we are introducing new product experiences and AI-assisted capabilities. You do not need to be an expert in every framework, but you must be able to lead safely across technical boundaries. You will have the possibility to form part of our established office environment in Lithuania, Copenhagen, London, or Odense! This is an exciting and transformative time to join Relesys, as we have gone into a strategic partnership with the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital, where the coming years will bring extensive growth and opportunities along the way. You get a unique opportunity to make a tremendous impact in taking your career, Relesys and our dear clients to the next level over the coming years - as we say it, joining a scale-up at this stage is a rare opportunity that is "once in a lifetime". 🚀

**Your Key Responsibilities

• Own ambiguous, high-impact frontend initiatives from discovery through production, including the outcome and not only the implementation tasks

• Partner with Product and Design to clarify the customer problem, challenge assumptions and shape an achievable solution

• Lead technical discovery and frontend design, making trade-offs between delivery speed, user experience, maintainability and migration cost explicit

• Break complex initiatives into safe milestones with appropriate testing, telemetry, feature flags and rollback plans

• Design and implement accessible, responsive and resilient experiences while evolving our frontend architecture and design system incrementally

• Take responsibility for production outcomes, investigate difficult problems, prevent recurring issues and adjust the solution when evidence changes

Furthermore, it would be great, but not required, if you have/are:

**Our Culture

We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. **About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Interested?

**If you want significant technical ownership while helping shape how modern software is developed at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.
